import json,collections
rs=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[39]['slots']['1']='u'; a[39]['confidence']['1']='low'; a[39]['note']='First final glyph is heavily worn at the stem top.'
a[85]['slots']['1']='u'; a[85]['note']='Final glyph is displaced and damaged; its top and bowl are unclear.'; a[85]['pre1918']='unclear'
open('answers.jsonl','w').writelines(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n' for x in a)
assert len(a)==len(rs)
for r,b in zip(rs,a):
 assert r['item_id']==b['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(b['slots'])==expected==set(b['confidence'])
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in b['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in b['confidence'].values())
 assert b['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(v for b in a for v in b['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(a),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(c),'total',sum(c.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(b['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for b in a))
